hints: A tangent line is perpendicular to the radius drawn to the point of tangency.
So triangle $OPT$ is a right triangle with legs $OT = r$ and $PT$, and hypotenuse $OP$.
solution_steps_latex: Key fact: a tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of tangency.
